Definition: from G4253 and G991; to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance:--provide.
BiblicalUsage: Problepo means to look out beforehand, to provide in advance, and the writer to the Hebrews uses it once. God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God provided for the old saints with us in mind, and their perfection waits for ours.
